components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with near-black background and white text. Scale micro-interaction on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.205 0 0) 80%, black); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 10px; } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action button with border and transparent background. Fills to muted on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 14px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 10px; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Minimal button with no background or border. Used in toolbars and navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; } }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Danger action button with translucent red background. Never solid red.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325) 10%, transparent); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325) 20%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-destructive { height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input with border stroke, transparent background, and focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 14px; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.708 0 0) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.922 0 0) 50%, transparent); } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; } }

narrative.overview: Multi-POS is a working tool, not a showcase. Its visual language prioritizes speed, scanability, and operational clarity over decorative expression. The system feels precise and confident — every element earns its space through function, not flourish. Density is configurable per-organization, and the palette shifts with hue-based theming, but the structural logic remains constant: flat surfaces, clear hierarchy, and zero visual noise between the operator and their task.
keyCharacteristics: Flat-by-default surfaces with tonal layering for depth
Dynamic hue-based theming (primaryHue + accentHue configurable per tenant)
Adaptive navigation: sidebar → bottom tab bar → navigation drawer
Touch-first POS with large targets, virtual keyboard, and barcode scanner
Monochrome base palette with destructive red as the sole accent color

rules.name: The Monochrome Foundation Rule
rules.body: The default palette is achromatic. Color enters only through dynamic hue theming or the destructive red.

rules.name: The Destructive-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: The only chromatic color in the base system is destructive red. It appears on ≤5% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Configurable Scale Rule
rules.body: The base font size is 16px * fontScale. Never hardcode font sizes in px that bypass this system.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only for overlays (dialogs, popovers) or state responses.

dos: Do use the density system (compact/comfortable/spacious) rather than hardcoding gaps.
Do keep the destructive color reserved for errors and dangerous actions.
Do use ring-1 ring-foreground/10 for card borders instead of box-shadow.
Do scale button and input sizes for mobile using the responsive pattern.
Do use Poppins for headings and Montserrat for body.
Do respect the configurable radius system using var(--radius) derivatives.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to cards or surfaces.
Don't use color for decorative purposes.
Don't hardcode font sizes — always use the fontScale-aware rem system.
Don't place more than 5 items in the mobile bottom tab bar.
Don't use rounded-full on buttons or inputs.
Don't mix Poppins and Montserrat in the same text block.
